description: Applies RG ideas from statistical physics: coarse-graining Collatz dynamics on residue classes mod 2^k reveals scale-invariant structure.
mathematical_formalization: T_k: Z/(2^k Z) -> Z/(2^k Z), k-step iteration on residue classes. Fixed points → self-similar trajectories.
implementation_hypothesis: Compute T_k for k=1..20, identify high-delay residue classes, build renormalization tree.
experiment_seed: Average delay per residue class mod 2^k, k=1..16, up to 2^30.
